basics.name: Michał Kamiński
basics.label: Senior .NET Developer | AWS Enthusiast
basics.summary: I'm a .NET developer with over a decade of experience, dedicated to the travel industry since 2016. For over 3 years I have also led a team of 8 people delivering many valuable features to the customer. Professionally and personally an AWS enthusiast, currently focusing on certification to expand my technical knowledge.
